result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and written deletion certification. However, it goes beyond the playbook by requiring return and deletion of all Works, Confidential Information, and Company materials—not merely Customer Data—and applies that obligation upon termination of any single Statement of Work, potentially affecting materials unrelated to that SOW. Those overbroad additions are not necessary and may alter unrelated rights or record-retention expectations.
